_doc: MCP servers Jarvis loads (core/config.py load_servers). Phase-2 integrations are entries with policy 'integration': they load only when enabled, are read-only unless read_only is false, and every tool not in read_tools is a write that needs Trevor's spoken yes (auto_write: tool -> settings key that lets it run without one). Without a policy, every tool asks unless named in auto_allow. Secrets (OAuth tokens, feed URLs): system keyring via core/secrets.py, never in this file. Connect with `jarvis connect <auth>`; see docs/phase2-*.md.
